# Introduction {#sec-intro}

This document uses the UW–Madison brand identity: **Badger Red** headings, 
*Crimson Pro* for body text, and Red Hat Display for headings and sans-serif 
elements.

## Using Brand Colors Inline

You can apply brand colors directly in LaTeX raw blocks:

`\badgerred{This text is Badger Red.}`{=latex}

`\darkred{This text is Dark Red.}`{=latex}

## Colored Boxes

Use the custom box environments with raw LaTeX blocks.

```{=latex}
\begin{uwbox}[Key Concept]
This is a primary Badger Red callout box — good for important notes, 
definitions, or key takeaways.
\end{uwbox}
```

```{=latex}
\begin{uwinfo}[Background]
This is a light gray info box — good for supplementary context or 
background information.
\end{uwinfo}
```

```{=latex}
\begin{uwaccent}[Warning]
This is a dark red accent box — good for warnings or critical points.
\end{uwaccent}
```

# Figures and Illustrations {#sec-figures}

## R-generated Figures

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "A sample ggplot2 figure using UW brand colors."
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 3.5

# Example plot using theme_uw() and scale_fill_uw()
tibble(
  group = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  value = c(42, 67, 31, 55)
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_uw(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Value", y = NULL) +
  theme_uw(grid = "x")
```

## Brand Illustrations

After downloading illustrations from the brand site and placing them in 
`assets/illustrations/`, include them with:

```markdown
![Caption for the illustration.](assets/illustrations/bascom-hall.svg){width=80%}
```

Or via the LaTeX helper (gives more layout control):

```{=latex}
% \uwillustration{filename.svg}{10cm}
```

## Brand Icons

After downloading icons to `assets/icons/`, use them inline or as figures:

```markdown
![](assets/icons/research.svg){height=1.5cm}
```

Or inline in a sentence via the LaTeX helper:

```{=latex}
% Research \uwiconinline{research.svg} is central to UW–Madison's mission.
```
